description: The finished code. A component comes as plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript (format "single" for one HTML file, "files" for three). A section comes as its self-contained code.html. A whole page or AI dashboard comes as one HTML file and is part of Herofold Pro. Photos and video are licensed for Herofold only, so the code expects your own media.

format.description: Components (type motion) only: one HTML file (default) or three files

id.description: The item's id from search: a page slug, a section (block) id, a component (motion) id or an AI dashboard (chat) slug

type.description: page, block (a page section), motion (an animated AI component or an AI platform screen) or chat (an AI dashboard)
